stories.title: Williams' 26, late free throws lift Valkyries past Dream in G1
stories.summary: - Gabby Williams converted two free throws with 1:18 left to put Golden State ahead, two more with 4.1 seconds to go and finished with 26 points facing constant pressure from Atlanta's stingy defense, and the Valkyries held off the Dream 68-64 in Game...

stories.title: Eagles star QB Hurts placed on IR, expected to be out indefinitely
stories.summary: The Eagles have decided to place Jalen Hurts on injured reserve after consultations with numerous doctors and experts, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

stories.title: Ohio State survives Indiana on Marsh's fourth-down misstep
stories.summary: Ohio State survived what appeared to be the go-ahead score when Nick Marsh's left foot was ruled to be out of bounds as the Buckeyes beat Indiana 19-15 on Saturday.

stories.title: Sources: Bears plan to start QB Williams in Week 6 vs. Falcons
stories.summary: The Bears are planning to start Caleb Williams against the Falcons after the star QB missed the past three games, sources told NFL Network and ESPN.

stories.title: Durant, Ishbia go back and forth over framing of Suns tenure
stories.summary: Kevin Durant fired back at Suns owner Mat Ishbia on social media for framing Phoenix's acquisition of Durant as a mistake.
